description: This PHP class defines the SupervisorModel in the OrangeHRM performance API module. It models supervisor data for serialization, representing a supervisor entity with properties like employee number, name, and termination ID, based on a ReportTo entity.

classes.name: SupervisorModel
classes.description: A model class representing supervisor data for API serialization, built from a ReportTo entity and implementing the Normalizable interface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with a ReportTo entity and sets up attribute filters and names for serialization.
